requirements.required_evidence: All six original questions pass computed source, answer, planner, supported service, owned work, reopen and follow-up checks. Explicit uncertainty is allowed; missing implementation is not.

One connected population/program execution with full roster and time scope, independently reconciled denominators, matched/nonmatched/unresolved members, supported opportunities, buyer capacity, payer/consent prerequisites, work ownership and internal follow-through. Demonstrate another program composition without a dedicated question handler.

Changed, conflicting and late evidence recomputes the affected saved findings and work; unchanged results retain identity. Exact source clocks, dependencies, unresolved references and proposed acquisition remain inspectable.

Pinned active release, exact original roster and received-record coverage; public metadata comparison for a deliberate migration; independent synthetic source mapping variant, explicit missing mappings, repeatable activation and recovery. Migration must not silently transfer stale models.

Scoped outcome/horizon with availability-safe features and labels, censoring/missingness, reproducible baseline and prediction result or specific evidence-based inability to estimate; displayed through the question path with source/model versions.

Source-linked population finding with temporal or process explanation, competing hypotheses, assumptions, multiplicity controls when searching, and a simple-baseline comparison. No causal claim without supported identification.

Program work and follow-up connect to outcomes and versioned attribution/OAP/contract definitions. Actual service/adjudication/payment/balance inputs reconcile independently; scenario opportunity remains separate from received savings, with unresolved attribution explicit.

Actual question path selects an appropriate code/local/specialist/frontier route; exact caching, bounded evidence, failed-key protection, full request/retry/review accounting and declared fallback/abstention are verified on equivalent task inputs.

Reproducible local startup/configuration, stable interfaces, adapter conformance, restart/reopen, backup/restore and transaction recovery; final design-to-code mapping retains every acceptance area and records external dependencies.

Source-family-disjoint fitting/calibration/evaluation and honest role-specific baseline comparisons, selective thresholds, unsupported-claim/temporal/service errors, useful coverage and cost. Machine-authored labels remain identified; preserve negative results and unqualified roles.
Real independent qualified clinical review and appropriate outcome validation before clinical accuracy or clinical deployment claims. Synthetic engineering tests cannot satisfy this requirement.

Customer-specific authentication/tenant controls, governed EHR/pharmacy/scheduling/payer adapters, live benefit verification, clinician authority and deployment authorization. No employer access or actual outreach is authorized by this local release.
